title: Best Christmas Snow Globe!!
text:
Best Christmas Snow Globe!!. Update: 12/4/21: Motor failed after about 2 weeks.

I love this Christmas snow globe! It's awesome! It runs on either batteries or a USB cable. When it's powered on, it lights up and the glitter/snow continuously moves around. It also plays fun traditional Christmas songs. You can opt to turn the music off and just have the lights and the moving glitter if you prefer. The globe looks like a lantern. It's got me in the Christmas spirit already!

product_metadata.title: Eldnacele Christmas Snow Globe Lantern Spinning Water Glittering with Timer & Music, 11” Lighted Swirling Snow Globe Lantern USB and Battery Operated for Christmas Decoration and Gifts(Santa)
features: 🎁PACKAGE LIST: You will get 1 pc Christmas snow globe, inside the lighted water glittering sits in a santa, built-in motor continuously swirls the water and glitters to fill up the inner space when power on. The dimension of the music snow globe is L4.3 x W4.3 x H11.4". 1 x USB to DC cable and 1 x User manual.

🎁THREE WAY SWITCH: MUSIC-OFF-TIMER three-way slide switch on the bottom of the lighted snow globe lantern, Music for light on glitter swirling and music playing; TIMER for light on and glitter swirls (music not playing) for 6 hours on and 18 hours off, cycle every 24 hours automatically.

🎁MUSIC PLAYING: Once turn the switch to MUSIC position, the snow globe cycle plays eight different tunes: Jingle Bells, We Wish You a Merry Christmas, Silent Night, Deck the Halls, Joy to the World, The First Noel, Hark! The Herald Angel Sings and Oh, Christmas Tree!

🎁TWO MODE POWER SUPPLY: Included USB to DC cable makes the musical snow globes work without batteries. Or can operate it by 3 AA batteries (not included), so that you can place it in anyplace that you want to add a sparkle of light! Long lasting batteries can work for a whole holiday season in timer mode. Please note USB and Batteries can not work at the same time.

🎁CHRISTMAS DECO: A must have addition to your holiday collection this year! Special and unique design will impress anyone who saw it at the first sight. Great Christmas presents suit all ages, get it now for your families and friends, buy once for a whole year enjoyment.
